name: io.github.wgt19861219/godot-mcp-enhanced
description: Enhanced Godot 4.5-4.7 MCP: headless+editor+bridge, secure GDScript sandbox, closed-loop AI dev. — 46 tools

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Godot executable (auto-detected from PATH / GODOT_PATH / project config if omitted)

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_PROJECT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Default Godot project path (auto-detected from the client's cwd if omitted)

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_PROJECT_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated whitelist of project paths the server may operate on (security boundary; falls back to GODOT_MCP_UNRESTRICTED for local dev)
